text:
Before: coffee with milk (~250ml), cola (~200ml), 2 cookies, toasted sandwich (2 triangles), sub roll (two halves, chicken/cheese/lettuce), fruit salad bowl.

After: coffee and cola finished. Cookies gone and the toasted sandwich gone, with crumbs left on the plate. About one sub half remains plus a small piece of the other half, so roughly half the sub was eaten. Some fruit was eaten, maybe 40%; the sugar packet is unused.

Estimates:
- Coffee with milk, 250 g: ~60 kcal
- Cola, 200 g: ~85 kcal
- Cookies, 2 × 15 g = 30 g: ~140 kcal
- Toasted sandwich, ~130 g: ~330 kcal
- Sub, total ~350 g at ~600 kcal; eaten ~45%, so ~160 g: ~270 kcal
- Fruit, ~250 g total; eaten ~100 g: ~45 kcal

Totals: mass ≈ 250 + 200 + 30 + 130 + 160 + 100 = 870 g; kcal ≈ 60 + 85 + 140 + 330 + 270 + 45 = 930.

{"kcal": 930, "mass_g": 870}
